items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Unlikely to play Week 7; monitor Friday report closely.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs in two-minute/red-zone.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice on Thursday for the Jets.
items.why: Quad recovery; returned to practice after missing time.
items.implication: Trending toward Week 7 availability vs MIA; snap share rebound expected.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full carries/routes if cleared; reduces handcuff upside.

items.text: David Montgomery (groin) not expected to play Week 7 vs Giants per reports; DNP continuing. Kyle Monangai ruled OUT for Bears TNF (thumb/turf toe, third straight miss).
items.implication: HOU lead back to Marks (high snap/touch share vs soft NYG run D); CHI RB committee without Monangai.
items.opportunity: Marks elevated carries/routes/third-down; CHI backups snap increase.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP; TE Elijah Arroyo undergoing season-ending shoulder surgery and to IR.
items.why: Full practice participant; 21-day window closed. Arroyo season-ending.
items.implication: Charbonnet could debut in some capacity vs KC; SEA backfield competition increases. TE vacuum for other SEA pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet role expansion potential as lead/change-of-pace; reverse prior SEA RB beneficiaries.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess contributes. Discussed Jacobs long-term on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Positive ramp indicators despite limited on-field; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs likely plays/starts Week 7 vs DET with path to lead role ROS if cleared fully; devalues Lloyd.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down carries shift back to Jacobs; monitor practice participation.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs due to workload questions post-layoff

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears a good place to find yardage; Brown back in real role with usage and matchup lined up.
items.why: Removed from injury report; strong matchup vs Bears secondary allowing yardage; real role/usage.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with upside in favorable spot.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18). Workload question after long layoff.
items.why: Layoff rust; uncertain immediate workload vs DET.
items.implication: Fade or cautious start despite positive facility news.
items.conflict: Levitan notes facility access and bad backup EPA as positive for Jacobs role

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups. Saquon Barkley in line to play vs DAL (efficient prior, great matchup).
items.why: Volume + soft run defenses; Saquon hamstring recovery on track for MNF.
items.implication: Strong RB2/FLEX starts; Saquon RB1 upside if full.
items.opportunity: High carries/snaps/goal-line for all; Saquon restores Eagles RB hierarchy.

items.text: JJ McCarthy yards per target when throwing to Justin Jefferson at 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but concerning. McCarthy starting Week 7.
items.why: Low YPT efficiency with McCarthy; scheme/sample caveats.
items.implication: Jefferson volume may hold but efficiency/fantasy ceiling tempered until chemistry improves.
items.opportunity: Still high routes/targets but lower YAC/YPT risk.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR next week) recovery will take time and not expected ready soon. Notable as he was biggest beneficiary of Davante Adams injury. Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Adams out 6-10 weeks; Ferguson delayed; extreme target concentration on Nacua.
items.implication: Puka elite WR1 volume ROS with massive target share, routes, red-zone opportunity.
items.opportunity: 25+ targets/game ceiling; high snap/route share in all situations.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume and matchup juice.
items.why: Elite volume; Cowboys defense soft for pass catchers.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6). Lions defense gift to opposing pass catchers all season.
items.why: Matchup vs Lions soft vs TE/pass; usage aligned.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32). Nasty matchup and role not ideal.
items.why: Tough Patriots defense; target share/role concerns on Bears.

items.text: Hates Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41). Target-share problem on low-scoring offense plus matchup.
items.why: Low target share; Colts low-scoring; Vikings defense.
